label: pSC101 ori
note: The pSC101 origin of replication: the ~220 bp low-copy, iteron-driven cis origin that controls RepA-initiated replication of the narrow-host-range plasmid pSC101. Temperature sensitivity of pSC101 replication maps to the rep101 gene, not to this origin (Armstrong et al. 1984), so no form of this origin carries a 'ts' claim.

label: RepA iteron 1
note: First of three tandem ~18 bp direct-repeat iterons (shared 17 bp core TGTAAATTCTGCTAGAC).

label: RepA iteron 2
note: Second RepA-binding iteron; identical 17 bp core (TGTAAATTCTGCTAGAC) to iteron 1, differing only in the leading base (C->T).

label: RepA iteron 3
note: Third (innermost) RepA-binding iteron; differs from iterons 1/2 by a single central base (T->C, core CCGCTAGAC).

label: AT-rich bending region
note: AT-rich tract (82.4% AT) lying between the iterons and the DnaA box.

label: DnaA
note: DnaA-box-like motif on the reverse strand (revcomp of seq[211:220] = TTATACACA; near the DnaA consensus TTAT[C/A]CACA).

provenance.sequence_source: NC_002056 (Salmonella plasmid pSC101, complete sequence; Bernardi & Bernardi 1984), complement(5003..5225), 100% over 223 bp; identical in K00042 complement(480..702). This is the native pSC101 sequence; many cloning vectors carry a variant with SmaI and BglII sites in place of bases 32-43 (catalog part 'pSC101 ori (SmaI/BglII vector form)').
